definitions.explanation: The state of a bill, fee, or debt having already been paid in full. Often marked on invoices and receipts.

examples.japanese: この{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}は{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みだ。
{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みの{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}。
{料金|りょうきん}はすでに{支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みなので{追加|ついか}の{請求|せいきゅう}はない。
examples.english: The fee has already been paid, so there will be no additional charge.

notes:
{済|ず}み is a suffix meaning "finished, already done," attached to many nouns and verb stems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みの{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: paid invoice
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}みマーク: "paid" stamp

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未払|みばら}い: unpaid — the antonym
- {入金済|にゅうきんず}み: payment received — the same state seen from the recipient's side
